lines.text: A silhouetted ballerina stands in fifth position, feet neatly crossed.
She springs straight up in a soubresaut, feet together, one arm sweeping high.
lines.delivery: light, buoyant, lifting with the jump

lines.text: Gliding, she leaps again, arms opening wide like wings.

rejected.draft: Gliding left, she leaps again, arms opening wide like wings.
rejected.reason: it says left, but the measured travel was no clear direction

lines.text: From a deep plié bend, she launches into a soaring sissonne split leap.
lines.delivery: expansive, suspended, matching the high leap

lines.text: Flowing through a graceful port de bras, she arches toward the light.
